events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the diagnostic and secure access
events.decision: Will the sponsor open access to waiting-time data and staff at all three hospitals?
agenda: Align on the diagnostic objective and the three hospitals in scope
Review the data and people needed for the baseline and journey maps
Decide on access to waiting-time data and staff

events.label: Check-in: causes of waiting
events.purpose: Review evidence and set findings focus
events.decision: Which tested causes of waiting should the cross-hospital readout detail?
agenda: Present the waiting-time baseline and patient journey maps
Review the causes of waiting tested against data
Decide which causes the cross-hospital findings detail

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Review findings and close the diagnostic
events.decision: Does the medical director accept the waiting-time findings as the basis for action?
agenda: Review the baseline, journey maps and causes behind the findings
Decide whether the findings are the basis for action
